name: otta
description: The self-learning AI software factory. Turns any Claude Code session into a TDD build → review → verify → ship pipeline run by specialist subagents, gated on acceptance criteria and schedulable as a cloud routine. Every gate verdict feeds the LEARN layer (GEPA) so the factory improves itself — plus DORA + idea→version metrics via the Otta Pulse GitHub App.

monitors.name: otta-post-ship-gate-watch
monitors.description: Opt-in: after /otta:ship opens a PR, watches the Otta Gate / CI checks on it to terminal status. scripts/otta-deploy-verify.sh polling remains the fallback on harnesses without Monitor support.
